user.title: Choose the heater
user.description: Heat Defender is the sister of AC Defender. It keeps the heat off so you do not feel hot, and always allows heating when the room gets too cold.

data.freeze_rule: Raise the floor when it freezes outside

data_description.climate_entity_id: A climate entity that can heat.
data_description.heat_mode: Off keeps the heating off. No warmer than lets it heat up to a limit.
data_description.heat_cap: The warmest the heating may make the room. Only used for No warmer than.
data_description.floor: The room is never allowed to fall below this. It cannot be lower than 10 degrees and cannot be turned off.
data_description.freeze_rule: When it is freezing outside the floor is raised so pipes and the building stay safe.
data_description.safety_temperature: At or above this the room is too warm and the heating is turned off at once.

sensors.title: Optional sensors
sensors.description: Everything here can be left empty.

data_description.room_sensor: Use a sensor that is closer to you than the device's own thermometer. Leave empty to use the device's reading.
data_description.door_sensor: Lets the defender react when a door or window opens.
data_description.presence_entity: Lets the defender relax when nobody is home.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Used by the outdoor rules. A weather entity or a temperature sensor.
data_description.power_kw: Only used to estimate cost. Leave empty to see running time only.

guards.title: Which guards start on
guards.description: Safety guards always start on. You can change any guard later.

error.cannot_cool: That device cannot cool. Pick an air conditioner.
error.cannot_heat: That device cannot heat. Pick a heater or a heat pump.
error.temperature_too_low: That is below the lowest temperature the device accepts.
error.temperature_too_high: That is above the highest temperature the device accepts.
error.safety_below_target: The safety temperature must be higher than the temperature to hold.
error.band_crossed: This would cross the other defender. The temperature to hold must stay above the warmest the heater may make the room.
error.band_too_narrow: The two defenders need at least one degree between them so they do not take turns all day.
error.band_under_floor: The heater's lowest comfortable temperature must stay above its floor.
error.floor_too_low: The floor cannot be lower than 10 degrees.
error.floor_above_cap: The floor must be below the warmest temperature.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different device. Add it as a new defender instead.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Stands down for a number of hours. Safety guards keep watching.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How long to pause, from a quarter of an hour to a day.

also_sibling.name: Also the other defender
also_sibling.description: Applies the same to the other defender of this device when it is set up.

stop_everything.name: Stop everything
stop_everything.description: Sends no command at all, the floor rules included, until told to defend again. The device's own frost protection keeps working.

also_sibling.name: Also the other defender
also_sibling.description: Applies the same to the other defender of this device when it is set up.

defend_again.name: Defend again
defend_again.description: Ends a pause or a stop.

let_it_heat.name: Let it heat
let_it_heat.description: Pauses the defender for a number of hours so the heating can run freely.

hours.description: How long to let it heat, from a quarter of an hour to a day.
